project.name: workspace-portal
project.description:
Aggregator for the PORTAL product: the meme gallery, comments, the user's saved refs and the account-deletion process manager. Each module is an independent git repository; this pom only ties them into a single Maven reactor. It is a pure aggregator — NOT the parent of the modules.
The shared kernel (identity + the libraries BOTH products could want) lives in ../shared and feeds this reactor through ~/.m2 — build it first: (cd ../shared; ./mvnw install). What only the portal speaks — a meme, its thread, an author, what may be kept of a leaver's content — lives in portal-libs, HERE, and depends on the kernel rather than the other way round. infra-up.sh does exactly that. The F1 game is the OTHER product (../formula); the two share only identity.
